description: Defines classes and interfaces for Vulkan synchronization primitives in ANGLE, including SyncVk, EGLSyncVk, and helper class SyncHelper.

classes.name: SyncHelper
classes.description: Helper class implementing synchronization logic for Vulkan fences and events.

classes.name: SyncVk
classes.description: Implementation of Vulkan fence synchronization, inherits from SyncImpl.

classes.name: EGLSyncVk
classes.description: EGL synchronization object for Vulkan, inherits from EGLSyncImpl.

methods.name: releaseToRenderer
methods.description: Releases synchronization resources to the renderer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SyncHelper with a Vulkan context.

methods.name: clientWait
methods.description: Waits for the fence or event with a timeout.

methods.name: serverWait
methods.description: Waits on the server side for synchronization.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the synchronization object.
